_note: Controls which organisations appear in their own right in the charts.
always_show: keeps its own colour and legend entry however small its contribution,
so a partner with a single PR stays visible. Edit this when a new partner appears.
exclude: dropped from the charts entirely (still present in results.json).
Anything not listed here is folded into a single 'Other organisations' series and
listed by name, with its numbers, in the Smaller contributors table.
Nothing here changes the per-organisation data. The one exception is the project-wide
'project' block behind the headline figures: it ignores excluded organisations, and
'host' is the organisation the share of PRs from outside contributors is measured against.
